abilities.name: Lotus Step Footing
abilities.description: You can stand on a narrow ledge, rope or branch for a few breaths as if it were flat ground.
abilities.cost: Qi strain: legs tremble and the next run is slow

growth.grows: how thin a footing and how long you can stand on it

abilities.name: Meridian Tap
abilities.description: Touch a point on someone's arm to numb it for a minute, if you strike before they brace.
abilities.cost: Your own fingertips go numb for as long

growth.grows: how many points and how long the numbness lasts

abilities.name: Teacup Calm
abilities.description: Pour and drink tea slowly to settle a frightened or angry person who drinks with you, until the cup is empty.
abilities.cost: Needs real tea and a quiet minute; one guest at a time

growth.grows: how strong a feeling it can settle and how many guests

abilities.name: Sword Hum Reading
abilities.description: Hold a blade by the hilt and sense whether its last fight was won or lost, and how badly.
abilities.cost: Sharp headache if the blade killed someone

growth.grows: how many fights back it reads

abilities.name: Breath of the Mountain Gate
abilities.description: Hold your breath and your heartbeat slows enough that a careless search can miss you for a minute.
abilities.cost: Dizzy and pale afterwards; cannot repeat until you have rested

growth.grows: how long you can hold it and how close a search it fools

abilities.name: Falling Leaf Palm
abilities.description: Strike to push an opponent back several paces without bruising them, enough to break a grapple.
abilities.cost: Draws on qi: arm aches until the next meal

growth.grows: how far the push throws and how heavy a target

abilities.name: Sect Ledger Memory
abilities.description: Read a sect roster or disciple list once and recall every name and rank on it for a month.
abilities.cost: Forget a recent minor memory to make room

growth.grows: how long a list and how long you keep it

abilities.name: Iron Shirt Moment
abilities.description: Brace when a blow comes and your skin takes it like hardened leather for that one strike.
abilities.cost: Bruises bloom later; the next brace in the same fight is weaker

growth.grows: how heavy a blow and how many in a row

abilities.name: Face-Reading Glance
abilities.description: Look at someone during a bow and sense whether they hold you above or below them in their own reckoning.
abilities.cost: Staring too long is a public insult

growth.grows: how much of their regard it reveals

abilities.name: Herb-Bitter Tongue
abilities.description: Taste a broth or pill and you can name the herbs in it, and whether any of them is poison.
abilities.cost: A poisoned taste still makes you sick for an hour

growth.grows: how rare an herb and how small a dose it catches

abilities.name: Qi Tether Pull
abilities.description: Draw a thin line of qi from your finger to tug a light object across a room.
abilities.cost: Fingers ache; drains your breath for a minute

growth.grows: how heavy an object and how far

abilities.name: Closed-Door Seclusion
abilities.description: Spend a full night meditating behind a shut door to heal one wound or shake off a day's fatigue.
abilities.cost: Anyone who opens the door breaks it and you lose the night

growth.grows: how serious a wound and how many in one night
